Girl's Death in Baruipur Sparks Protests, Allegations of Rape and Murder

An 11-year-old girl was found dead in Baruipur, West Bengal, with reports of rape and murder. Her body was discovered stuffed in a sack. The incident triggered violent protests in the area, with reports of a mob killing.
